summary_en: This study tests a drug called AN4005 in adults with advanced solid tumors or relapsed or refractory lymphoma. AN4005 is taken by mouth twice a day (BID) at dose levels from 50 mg to 600 mg, and the length of treatment is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability and PK (how the body handles the drug), with the goal of finding the maximum tolerated dose and/or recommended phase 2 dose.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba un medicamento llamado AN4005 en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o linfoma recidivante o refractario. AN4005 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día (BID), en dosis de 50 mg a 600 mg, y la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerancia y la farmacocinética (PK, cómo el cuerpo maneja el medicamento), con el objetivo de encontrar la dosis máxima tolerada y/o la dosis recomendada para fase 2.
who_for: Age 18 or older, and able to give signed consent.
Life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Advanced solid tumor that is metastatic or unresectable, or relapsed or refractory lymphoma.
No standard life-prolonging treatment available, or standard treatment unsuitable according to the investigator.
not_for: Grade 3 or higher immune-related side effect from prior anti-PD-1, PD-L1 or other T-cell checkpoint therapy.
Systemic anticancer or investigational therapy within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives.
Live vaccine within 30 days before the first dose.
Another primary malignancy within the past 2 years, with listed exceptions.
Significant heart problems, such as heart failure above NYHA Class II or recent heart attack or stroke.
